architecture_name: Explainable Hypothesis-Driven Root Cause Analysis (RCA) Pipeline for Security Incident Investigation
summary: An 8-stage security analytics architecture that ingests heterogeneous telemetry, normalizes it into a common schema, correlates events into a time-aware investigation graph, and then runs an iterative hypothesis-and-evidence loop to rank possible explanations. The result is a reconstructed attack timeline and an explainable RCA report with a dashboard.
architecture_type: Layered data pipeline with an iterative reasoning loop (SIEM / XDR-style forensic investigation)
data_flow: Telemetry Sources -> Ingestion & Normalization -> Unified Event Store -> Correlation Engine -> Investigation Graph -> Hypothesis & Evidence Engine (loop) -> Timeline Reconstruction -> Explainable RCA Report & Dashboard

stages.name: Telemetry Data Sources
stages.purpose: Raw logs collected from across the environment

stages.name: Ingestion & Normalization
stages.purpose: Convert diverse log formats into uniform records

stages.name: Correlation Engine
stages.purpose: Connect related events and surface suspicious patterns
components: Build entity relationships (hosts, users, processes, IPs)

stages.name: Investigation Graph
stages.purpose: Time-aware graph of events and entities

stages.name: Hypothesis & Evidence Engine (Investigation Loop)
stages.purpose: Iteratively form, test and rank explanations of an incident

steps.name: Detect Incident Candidates
steps.detail: Find suspicious activity using rules or anomalies

steps.name: Generate Hypotheses
steps.detail: Multiple possible explanations, e.g. credential compromise, malicious process

steps.name: Derive Predictions
steps.detail: What evidence should exist if the hypothesis is true

steps.name: Search for Evidence
steps.detail: Find supporting, contradicting and missing evidence across telemetry

steps.name: Score & Rank Hypotheses
steps.detail: Combine evidence, update confidence, rank explanations

stages.feedback_loop: Refine hypotheses and re-check evidence (iterative loop from 6.5 back to 6.1)

stages.name: Timeline Reconstruction
stages.purpose: Identify earliest relevant event and reconstruct the attack chain

stages.name: Explainable RCA Report & Dashboard
stages.purpose: Present findings, evidence and next steps

key_design_principles: Normalization to a common schema enables cross-source correlation
Graph-based, time-aware representation of entities and events
Hypothesis-driven investigation: predictions are tested against supporting, contradicting and missing evidence
Explainability: every conclusion is traceable to evidence, with alternatives shown
Maps naturally to attack-chain / MITRE ATT&CK-style phases
